notes.title: Wilmot Works It Out is AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=syfKNCYnz_s;full][/previewyoutube]

Step into Wilmot's home life with Wilmot Works It Out, a puzzle building game about putting together beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of Wilmot's home! 

[b]Key Features: [/b]
🧩 Put together more than 60 different puzzles, with original art by Wilmot's Warehouse artist Richard Hogg
🏠 Unlock 7 different rooms in Wilmot's house
🪴 Unlock 20+ additional items to decorate Wilmot's home with
🐱/🐶 Adopt a cat or a dog
🎶 Another brilliant soundtrack by Wilmot's Warehouse composer & sound designer Eli Rainsberry

[h2]Looking for more organizational fun? [/h2]
After beating the main game, players will unlock Marathon mode! This mode provides hours of Wilmot's Warehouse-style organizing fun time!

notes.title: Wilmot's Warehouse - Patch Notes v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

You may have noticed other the past week or so, lots of little updates to Wilmot's Warehouse being pushed to Steam. We've just pushed v.1.0.2 live today so we thought we should post some patch notes for you all wondering what bugs have been fixed and what changes have been made to your favourite warehouse organization game.

New updates in 1.0.2:

- Added AZERTY keyboard support. You can turn this on in the Options menu.
- Fixed mouse/trackpad input problems on some Macs with Retina screens.
- Fixed fullscreen behaviour on some Macs.
- Fixed some issues where distant blocks could move if you clicked on them.
- Added "quit" option to main menu.
- Peeled a banana.

This update also includes these previous fixes:

- Added gamepad support for rearranging things in manifest.
- Fixed the manifest to save your arrangement of products.
- Fixed map view so it doesn't exit when you press F12 or PrtSc to take a screenshot.
- Fixed a bug where Wilmot's Warehouse started in the 1980s.

Thanks for playing Wilmot's Warehouse and please get in touch with us at support@thehollowponds.com if you have bugs, thoughts or issues!
